accepted_state: Initial eight-area capability expansion is complete.
Default operating phase is hardening, consolidation, outcome validation, and gap-oriented learning rather than default skill expansion.
GitHub mutation guard contracts exist and remain CI-validated; native provider interception is deferred unless a controllable dispatcher surface becomes available.
Every live skill entrypoint has a consolidation classification and routing overlap clusters have machine-readable primary ownership rules.
Skill Acquisition is phase-gated and must not trigger a new expansion wave without explicit request or demonstrated gap.
Agent Engineering treats executor/model claims as candidate state and requires evidence-appropriate promotion into durable accepted state.
Independent verifier/auditor roles should be read-only where practical; unauthorized verifier mutation contaminates verification evidence.
Long-horizon carryover prefers compact verified facts and references over replaying raw trajectories.
Tracing and evaluation are separate layers: traces describe execution while evals judge contract satisfaction.
A CI-validated trajectory contract now enforces privacy-minimal typed events, bounded retries, verification after successful mutation, and evidence-linked accepted-state promotion.
Core trajectory metadata must not persist raw prompts, raw responses, hidden reasoning, or chain-of-thought.
Executable continuity checkpoint state remains CI-validated.
unresolved_risks: The public Core guard cannot intercept native provider GitHub tools unless the host routes mutation calls through it.
Eight skills remain NEEDS_EVIDENCE and should not be promoted to stronger consolidation decisions without representative outcomes.
Routing boundaries, verified-state promotion, and trajectory contracts are contract-level refinements and still need representative real-task outcome evidence.
Available host tools do not always expose a complete replayable execution seam, so record/replay must not be simulated from incomplete logs.
A separate auditor agent is not assumed to improve every task; topology must remain evidence-driven and smallest-sufficient.

next_executable_step.action: On ordinary real tasks, capture only observable privacy-minimal trajectory metadata when the execution surface exposes it; shadow-score verification, retries, routing, rework, and correctness, then promote the first genuine observed failure into a small regression case. Do not fabricate missing traces or claim outcome improvement from the contract alone.
